title: Do open citations give insights on the qualitative peer-review evaluation in research assessments? An analysis of the Italian National Scientific Qualification
reasoning: The paper investigates potential social and procedural biases in an academic peer-review system. While this relates to the ethics of scientific evaluation, it does not evaluate or benchmark ethics, morals, or religion as a subject of study itself. The focus is on the fairness and potential biases within a specific process, not a broader evaluation of ethical frameworks.
